title: Finite-field scalar extension of constructible pro-etale complexes
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $k\to k'$ be a unital homomorphism of finite fields. Write $k_Y,k'_Y$ for the constant sheaves of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For a sheaf $F$ of $k_Y$-modules set $T(F)=F\otimes_{k_Y}k'_Y$, with the $k'_Y$-action on the right factor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then $T$ is exact and takes constructible $k_Y$-module sheaves to constructible $k'_Y$-module sheaves, where constructible means [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. More precisely, if $F$ restricts on a pro-etale cover of a locally closed constructible stratum $Z\subseteq Y$ to the constant sheaf associated to a finite $k$-module $V$, then $T(F)$ restricts on that cover to the constant sheaf associated to $V\otimes_k k'$, with its $k'$-module structure. For every cochain complex $C$ of $k_Y$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], termwise $T$ satisfies $\mathcal H^i(TC)\cong T(\mathcal H^i(C))$ as $k'_Y$-modules for every integer $i$. Consequently, for integers $r\le s$, if $\mathcal H^i(C)$ is constructible for every $i$ and is zero outside $[r,s]$, the same assertions hold for $TC$ with $k'$-coefficients.

proof.text: Use the proved constant-module encoding equivalence. Naturality of the constant-section sheafification unit identifies intrinsic scalar restriction followed by encoding with encoding followed by fixed-module scalar restriction, with identity maps on sections. Conjugate the fixed-module extension/restriction adjunction by the encoding equivalences and use pbcScalarAdjunction and uniqueness of left adjoints. This identifies intrinsic scalar extension with ProEtale.sheafExtendScalars under the equivalences. A field map is flat; the proved source-library preservesFiniteLimits_sheafExtendScalars theorem gives left exactness. Equivalences reflect finite limits. The intrinsic scalar adjunction gives preservation of finite colimits.

Apply the localized tensor-model comparison on each original stratum and exactly each original covering member. A finite k-module has a finite generating set. Its scalar extension is finitely generated over k', and a finitely generated module over a finite field is finite. Retain the positive finite stratification and constructible strata, and use the tensor-extended finite modules as the new witnesses. The extra local-model clause is the same comparison, with its cover hypotheses unused.

Constructibility is invariant under isomorphism: pull the isomorphism to each stratum, restrict to each covering object, and compose it with the existing finite constant-model identification. For a cochain complex, apply ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso to its three-term short complex in each degree using exactness. Use the preceding constructibility result and isomorphism invariance. Additivity preserves zero objects, so the homology comparison transports vanishing outside the original interval. This works degreewise without boundedness assumptions on the original complex. The existing placement of quantifiers and conjunctions in the Lean statement is retained verbatim.
